Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — rigging, a ship's wheel, coiled ropes, wooden stairs up to the quarterdeck and billowing sails
Outfit: a sea-glass green sailcloth wrap top made from three diagonally overlapping curved panels, secured by small wooden toggles at one side, with bare shoulders, an open neckline and an oval midriff cutout; high-waisted ivory split culottes and soft deck shoes complete the outfit. All panels covering bust and pelvis are opaque; no armor or regalia.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand reaches gently toward the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests lightly on her collarbone.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements; by position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
